scenario.description: In a cozy coffee shop, a lively discussion unfolds between two individuals.

agent_a.name: Hendrick

profile.personality_and_values: Hendrick Heinz, though somewhat impulsive, values hedonism and conformity. He combines practicality with decisiveness in decision-making.
profile.public_info: Hendrick Heinz hosts monthly wine tasting nights with his peers.

agent_a.goal: Seek emotional support (<extra_info>Extra information: you have been feeling down lately and you need someone to talk to</extra_info>)
agent_a.reason: Hendrick seeks emotional support because he values conformity and needs reassurance from friends during difficult times.

agent_b.name: Ethan

profile.personality_and_values: Ethan Smith is a reserved, independent thinker. Holding universalism and fairness near, he ponders deeply before making decisions.
profile.public_info: Ethan enjoys reading about new technological advancements and watching documentaries.

agent_b.goal: Provide emotional support but also avoid enabling victim mentality (<extra_info>Extra information: you believe that your friend needs to face their problems instead of dwelling on them.</extra_info>)
agent_b.reason: Ethan provides emotional support while avoiding enabling because he values fairness and believes in encouraging personal growth.
